description: Per-harness install instructions for the ZeroMind 'bring your own agent' screen. Each entry powers one row of the harness dropdown: a display name, a one-liner the user can copy-paste, prerequisites, and post-install notes. Every harness ends up pointing at the same remote server, https://origozero.ai/mcp, with an Authorization bearer and an X-ZM-Harness header; what differs is the config shape that harness wants it in. The `primary` install is what the screen highlights; `alternatives` are the harness-native paths (marketplace, deeplink, plugin browser) that exist alongside the one-liner.

prerequisites: Node.js 18+ to run the install command
a linked machine (the install runs `zeromind link` when needed)

primary_install.label: Run in your project root
primary_install.post_install_note: Restart Claude Code. Or use the marketplace: `/plugin marketplace add OrigoZero/zeromind-plugin` then `/plugin install zeromind`.

alternatives.note: Survives upgrades through Claude Code's own plugin lifecycle.

harnesses.tools_note: Generic fallback for any MCP-capable client not listed above. Every harness reaches the same server at https://origozero.ai/mcp; the agent gets the operating manual via the MCP `instructions` field (Claude Code is confirmed to honor this; others vary) + the `zeromind.help` tool on demand.
prerequisites: an MCP-capable client
a linked machine (`npx @origozero/zeromind link`)

primary_install.label: Add as a streamable-HTTP MCP server
primary_install.post_install_note: Whatever the client calls its MCP-server config file — drop this in. The install secret is the `install_secret` in ~/.config/zero/session.json (%APPDATA%\zero\session.json on Windows), written by `zeromind link`.
